confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors are rough aggregated estimates from mixed 2026 sources, mostly Sydney and Melbourne, with no official Wollongong dining index found. Cocktail and wine anchors are weaker and were set relative to beer and local pub prices. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not checked against live listings. The FX value comes from a search summary that cites the RBA overview and RSS feed; I did not verify it in the RBA F11 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional coastal New South Wales cities near Sydney, such as Newcastle and the Central Coast, used as the comparison basis, with Wollongong's commuter-belt pricing assumed slightly below Sydney.
